title: Multiplicity one, carrier equals support, and density one near a density-one point (Steps 2-3)
statement: Let n >= 1, U open in R^(n+l), V = v(M, theta) with generalized mean curvature H in U, p > n, H locally in L^p(mu_V), theta a positive integer mu_V-a.e., and xi in U with Theta^n(mu_V, xi) = 1. Suppose R > 0, the closed ball B_R(xi) lies in U, Q is a linear isometry, u : R^n -> R^l is C^1 on the open ball of radius R about 0, and Q(spt V - xi) cap (open B_R(0)) = graph of u over the open ball cap (open B_R(0)). Then there is s in (0, R] such that, with Bs the open ball of radius s about xi: (i) theta = 1 mu_V-a.e. on Bs; (ii) H^n((M cap Bs) symmetric-difference (spt V cap Bs)) = 0; (iii) mu_V restricted to Bs equals H^n restricted to spt V cap Bs; (iv) Theta^n(mu_V, y) = 1 for every y in Bs cap spt V; (v) for every rho in (0, s], H^n((Q(M - xi) cap open B_rho(0)) symmetric-difference graph of u over W_rho) = 0, where W_rho = {x in open B^n_rho(0) : |(x, u(x))| < rho}.
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (p : ℝ), (n : ℝ) < p → V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → V.LocallyLp H p → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k ∧ V.mult x = k) → ∀ ξ ∈ U, V.HasDensity ξ 1 → ∀ (R : ℝ) (Q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ), 0 < R → closedBall ξ R ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 R) → Q '' ((fun x => x - ξ) '' V.support) ∩ ball 0 R = graphOver u (ball 0 R) ∩ ball 0 R → ∃ s > 0, s ≤ R ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, x ∈ ball ξ s → V.mult x = 1) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (symmDiff (V.carrier ∩ ball ξ s) (V.support ∩ ball ξ s)) = 0 ∧ V.weight.restrict (ball ξ s) = (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict (V.support ∩ ball ξ s) ∧ (∀ y ∈ ball ξ s ∩ V.support, V.HasDensity y 1) ∧ ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ s → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (symmDiff (Q '' ((fun x => x - ξ) '' V.carrier) ∩ ball 0 ρ) (graphOver u {x | x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) ρ ∧ ‖graphPoint x (u x)‖ < ρ})) = 0
